findings.title: Exact duplicates found in raw data
findings.statement: The raw table contains 30 exact duplicate rows, representing 3.22% of the dataset prior to cleaning.
findings.recommendation: Remove exact duplicate rows to prevent distorted frequency counts in downstream analysis.

findings.title: Data quality score improved after cleaning
findings.statement: The data quality score increased from 95.2 out of 100 in the raw dataset to 100.0 out of 100 in the cleaned dataset.
findings.recommendation: Use the cleaned dataset for all further analysis to ensure no duplicate distortions remain.

findings.title: High right-skew in extra lines
findings.statement: The extra_lines column has a skew of 30.02 with a maximum value of 4.0 in the cleaned dataset.
findings.recommendation: Account for the highly skewed distribution of extra lines when investigating stack traces and multi-line records.

findings.title: Concentration of payment errors during bursts
findings.statement: Error burst 1 consists of 34 errors occurring over 7.0 minutes, with 100.0% originating from the payment logger.
findings.recommendation: Investigate the payment logger specifically around the burst start time to identify trigger conditions.

findings.title: Significant silence gap observed in timeline
findings.statement: A silence gap of 40.3 minutes was recorded with no log lines after the specified threshold.
findings.recommendation: Check upstream system availability and service health checks during the silence gap period.

narrative.headline: Payment errors are concentrated in bursts linked to the payment logger.

A critical finding reveals that Error burst 1 consists of 34 errors occurring over 7.0 minutes, with 100.0% originating from the payment logger. Additionally, a silence gap of 40.3 minutes was recorded, and extra_lines exhibited a skew of 30.02.
next_steps: Investigate the payment logger to determine the root cause of Error burst 1.
Examine the 40.3-minute silence gap in the timeline for system downtime or logging halts.
Review the high right-skew of 30.02 in extra_lines for potential multi-line stack trace anomalies.
